data.value: • Variables (Dim): Memory: Modifiable storage allocated during application runtime. Syntax: Dim studentName As String Multi-Declaration: Dim subTotal, total As Decimal • Constants (Const): Memory: Immutable fixed values defined and locked at compile time. Syntax: Const TAX_RATE As Decimal = 0.08D • Constant Categories: Named: Custom programmer-defined values using Const. Intrinsic: Built-in system constants (e.g., Color.Red, vbCrLf).

data.value: • First Character: Must begin with an alphabetic letter. • Allowed Characters: Letters, digits, and underscores (_). • Forbidden: No spaces, periods, or punctuation symbols. • Reserved Words: Cannot reuse keywords (Dim, Const, Sub). • Case Insensitive: TotalCount, TOTALCOUNT, and totalcount point to the exact same variable in memory.
